executive_assessment.text: The NDC reports annual surface temperature increased by about 0.14-0.19 degrees C per decade during 1979-2020, alongside fewer rainy days and longer dry spells.
The profile says women, children and other vulnerable groups were disproportionately affected by the 2015/16 drought.

The profile rates drought assessment and monitoring capacity as medium, while describing early-warning capacity as medium and noting gaps in comprehensive risk assessment and implementation coordination.
